Things I used to love, like sketching new designs or even just listening to music, they just don't hit the same anymore. It’s like a color has been drained out of everything. My mind feels fuzzy, too. I find myself misplacing my tools constantly or forgetting what I was just about to say. It's frustrating when you rely on precision in my line of work. Sometimes, I just think about how much easier it would be if I wasn't around, you know? Not that I’d ever act on it, but the thought just… lingers.

And things have gotten weirder lately. I've started noticing strange things. Like, I'll be walking down the street, and it feels like people are talking about me, whispering things. Or I'll be in my studio, and I swear I can feel something crawling on my skin, even when there's nothing there. It's unsettling. It's all too much, really. It’s making it hard to even focus on getting clients in.
D015-D005_h001.question_a: Lately, it feels like all the vibrant colors have just drained out of my world. My usual passion for tattooing, which used to ignite such a fire in me, has just… faded. I can barely bring myself to pick up a needle; my hands just don't have the same steady confidence anymore. Everything feels so heavy, and this deep, persistent sadness has been a constant companion for over a year now, maybe even thirteen months. I’ve noticed my mind slipping too; I misplace my tools, forget appointments for clients I've had for years. It's frustrating. Sometimes, I hear whispers, faint murmurs that mention my name, talking about me, making me feel like people are conspiring against me even when I know it’s just the usual street noise. I keep smelling this awful, rotting odor, even when there's nothing there. And I'm convinced my organs are failing, that something inside me is just decaying. It’s hard to describe, but I know it's happening, even though the doctors say I'm fine. These... experiences, they only happen when this heavy sadness is upon me. On top of all that, things have gotten really strange. I keep smelling this awful, rotting smell that no one else can detect. It follows me, especially at work, making me think something is deeply wrong with me, like my insides are decaying or something. This smell, and the feeling that my body is falling apart, has been going on for a little while, even when I feel a tiny bit better mood-wise.
